mentions.name: pingmebud
mentions.description: A macOS meeting-monitoring app that lets users join a meeting, hit start, and step away to do other work. It listens locally with Whisper and sends a native macOS notification with context when someone says the user's name or any configured keywords, so the user can jump back in without looking lost. It runs 100% locally and doesn't leave traces.
mentions.problem: Meeting fatigue: attending many meetings only 'just in case someone has a question' and needing a safe way to not pay attention to them.
mentions.audience: People who sit in many meetings and want to step away or focus on other work without missing when they're called on
mentions.source_excerpt: The idea is: you join a meeting, hit start on the app, minimize, and go do actual work (or go make a coffee). When someone says your name or any keyword(s) you set, you get a native macOS notification with enough context to jump back in without looking lost. It uses whisper and is 100% local and doesnt leave traces
